articles.summary: A hotel phone line should answer every call, know this property, stay current, and hand over before it guesses. Requirements a GM can test on any vendor.
articles.title: What a Hotel Phone Line Should Do in 2026

articles.summary: A practical comparison of four ways hotels handle the phone: IVR, voice bot, outsourced call center, and resolution-focused AI. Judged on one test: does a confirmed booking land in the PMS, or does a person enter it later.
articles.title: Hotel Phone Systems Compared: IVR, Voice Bot, Call Center, AI | Codyco
